      public void testRegistrationOrder() throws org.osgi.framework.InvalidSyntaxException
      Initially, the function services are registered first. The test method checks that rule.
      Throws:
      org.osgi.framework.InvalidSyntaxException - If the registered device UID breaks the LDAP filter.

    • testUnregistrationOrder

      public void testUnregistrationOrder() throws org.osgi.framework.InvalidSyntaxException, DeviceException
      The device service is unregistered first. The test method checks that rule.
      Throws:
      org.osgi.framework.InvalidSyntaxException - If the registered device UID can break the LDAP filter.
      DeviceException - An error while removing the device.
